info.bio:
Camper Van Beethoven es una banda de rock alternativo formada en 1983 en Redlands, California, aunque la banda enseguida se trasladaría a Santa Cruz, California. La música de Camper Van Beethoven mezcla pop, ska, punk rock, folk, country, y acid rock haciendo una ecléctica, pegajosa y a veces misteriosa combinación.

El grupo se separaría en  1990 y el vocalista David Lowery forma Cracker con el guitarrista Johnny Hickman. Se volvieron a reunir oficialmente en 2004 para grabar New Roman Times, su primer álbum oficial en 15 años.

scenes.name: Roots-rock de los ochenta y cow-punk
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Como en 1970 tras 1966, la new wave de 1976 va seguida de un revival del roots-rock, esta vez gradual y disfrazado: punks que desfiguran los estilos tradicionales (X, Dream Syndicate, Gun Club) y los «cow-punks» que tocan country ambientado entre inadaptados: Long Ryders, Jason & The Scorchers, Fetchin Bones, Lone Justice, Beat Farmers. El populismo de Los Lobos, Del Fuegos, Del-Lords y Walkabouts; en la Costa Oeste, los dementes Camper Van Beethoven, Donner Party, Catheads, Thin White Rope y los American Music Club de Mark Eitzel; en Texas, Wild Seeds, Poi Dog Pondering, Glass Eye; en los Grandes Lagos, BoDeans, Soul Asylum, Afghan Whigs, Shrimp Boat y los canadienses Cowboy Junkies. Nashville se renueva con los neotradicionalistas (George Strait, Randy Travis, Garth Brooks, Lyle Lovett, Steve Earle, Dwight Yoakam) y el surf instrumental vuelve con Shadowy Men On A Shadowy Planet.

podcast.title: San Francisco Area Origin (1983)
podcast.body: Camper Van Beethoven originated from the San Francisco area, with a history dating back to at least 1983, a period considered the earliest days of what would become known as alternative music. "They're from the San Francisco area. I'm going to have a history that goes back to at least 1983."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: David Lowery's Academic and Writing Career
podcast.body: Singer David Lowery is a lecturer in the music business program at the University of Georgia and maintains a website called `The Trichordist`, where he writes on music. "And singer David Lowry works as a lecturer in the music business program at the University of Georgia, plus he has a website where he writes on music called The Trichortist."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: David Lowery's Diverse Background
podcast.body: Frontman David Lowery was trained as a mathematician and later worked as a financial analyst and a trader of derivatives, a profession described as largely misunderstood. His varied background informed his witty, droll, smart-assy, and often nonsensical lyrics. "Out front was David Lowry, a mathematician by training who would later work as a financial analyst and a traitor of derivatives, something that almost no one really understands."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Mostly Hitless 80s Band
podcast.body: Camper Van Beethoven was described as a "mostly hitless 80s band." Its former frontman, Dave Lowery, later achieved significant success leading the band Cracker. "former frontman of the mostly hitless 80s band Camper Van Beethoven."

podcast.title: Spin-off Group Cracker
podcast.body: Camper Van Beethoven still exists today, as does their spin-off group, Cracker, which achieved significant alt-rock hits in the 1990s. "Campers still exist today as does their spin-off group Cracker. They had some big all-rock hits in the 90s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Surrealist, Absurdist Folk Style
podcast.body: From their inception, Camper Van Beethoven embraced a style they termed "surrealist, absurdist folk." Their music incorporated elements of punk alongside folk music, and their lineup occasionally featured a violinist and ska beats. "From the beginning, the band was into what they called surrealist, absurdist folk. They had elements of punk to what they were doing. But they also seemed to like folk music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
